title: Palindrome Partitioning

monster.name: Mirror Hydra
monster.title: Splitter of Palindromic Segments
monster.defeatQuote: All substrings checked for palindromes at every partition point!

description: Given a string `s`, partition `s` such that every substring of the partition is a palindrome. Return all possible palindrome partitioning of `s`.
constraints: s contains only lowercase English letters
hints: Backtrack over prefix lengths. If prefix is palindrome, recursively partition remaining string.
